name: Greencrest Financial Services Limited
about: Greencrest Financial Services Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in finance and investment businesses in India. The company is also involved in shares & other securities, government and non-government bonds, fixed deposits, commodities and other related activities of capital market. The company was formerly known as Marigold Glass Industries Limited and changed its name to Greencrest Financial Services Limited in May 2013. Greencrest Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Kolkata, India.
